funding_grade_stability_rule: errors/timeouts zero; cleanup passes; p99 no more than 1.25x the lowest-load p99 for the same affinity mode; achieved/offered at least 0.95; backlog bounded and drained; repeat CV no more than 0.05
achieved_offered_definition: This is a closed-loop workload. Achieved/offered is the maximum observed outstanding depth divided by configured outstanding depth, capped at 1.0; zero errors and successful cleanup separately prove completion and drain behavior.

highest_repeatable_cell.reason: p99 exceeds 1.25x the 0x55 one-group lowest-load baseline

repeat_extension: No cell exceeded the 5 percent CV threshold after five longer-window repeats, so the approved extension to ten repeats was not triggered.
scope_limit: The strict-stable ceiling applies only to this Windows laptop, loopback, 16 KiB, one-stream, outstanding-four, endpoint-per-group benchmark topology. It is not a WAN, NIC, server-class, or production deployment ceiling.
